title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?
description: Seven real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, Kaiser Wilhelm II, King George V, Queen Elizabeth II, Justin Trudeau and Mike Myers.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?

image.file: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-S38324, Tag von Potsdam, Adolf Hitler, Paul v. Hindenburg.jpg

links.line: In 1933, Hitler shook hands with President Hindenburg, who made him chancellor.
In 1917, Hindenburg planned the war with Kaiser Wilhelm II.

image.file: File:The Nine Sovereigns at Windsor for the funeral of King Edward VII.jpg

links.line: In 1910, the Kaiser posed at Windsor with his cousin, King George V.

image.file: File:3-5 (i.e. 6)-33, anniversaire du roi George V (la famille royale au balcon de Buckingham Palace) - btv1b532749892.jpg

links.line: In 1933, George V stood on the palace balcony with little Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Prime Minister Boris Johnson G7 Summit Day One - 51242021245.jpg

links.line: In 2021, the Queen hosted Justin Trudeau at the G7 in Cornwall.

image.credit: Justin Trudeau on Twitter (via The Quint)

links.line: In 2016, Trudeau greeted fellow Canadian Mike Myers at the White House.
And in 2001, Mike Myers became the voice of Shrek.

research_note: Edward VII's 1910 funeral put the Kaiser in one photo with his cousin George V; the royals carry the chain to Trudeau, who greeted Mike Myers at a White House dinner.
fun_fact: Kaiser Wilhelm II and King George V were first cousins, both grandsons of Queen Victoria, yet led opposite sides in World War I.
